probe.document_title: Senior Software Engineer — Backend (Files Team) - Databricks

lines: The filesystem has emerged as the preferred runtime interface for agentic AI.
AI agents use the filesystem for context, memory management, artifact (dashboard, code etc) authoring, version control, sandboxing, and interacting between systems and agents.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Files team, you will innovate at the intersection of storage, performance, and distributed systems, directly shaping our filesystem strategy to power next-generation agentic workloads.
## The Impact You’ll Have
Design, build, and operate the the filesystem platform powering tens of thousands of data, AI and agentic workloads daily
## What We’re Looking For
Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related field
5+ years of production-level experience in Java, Scala, C++, Go, Rust, or a similar language
3+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or MicroVM technologies (e.g., Firecracker) and a strong grasp of cloud provider internals (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Experience building object/blob storage (S3, Azure Blob Storage, GCS etc)
Systems performance engineering across microservices, down to the Linux level
## Pay Range Transparency
The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above.

probe.document_title: Sr. Software Engineer - Ingestion Core team - Databricks

lines: Deeply understanding what’s in the enterprise data has been a challenge that Databricks has been addressing by providing analytics and machine learning tools.

From data warehousing with Databricks SQL to large-scale distributed processing with Spark and advanced ML tools for experimentation and model serving, we empower our customers to gain insights and drive innovation.

This role requires building distributed platform systems to incrementally ingest high-volume, petabyte-scale data from diverse sources—including cloud storage (SQS, ADLS, GCS), databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Postgres), and file sources (Google Drive, SharePoint)—at high throughput and low cost.
Join us in making data ingestion effortless and be part of the team that powers the future of AI + data at Databricks!
## As an engineer on the team, you will work on projects that
Reduce end-to-end latency, increase throughput, and reduce costs from the time data appears in source systems to when it is available in Delta Lake.
Collaborate with partner teams to enable use cases like RAG and AI agents.
Build Agentic SDKs with strong evaluations.
## Ideal Engineer should have
5+ years of experience writing production code in one of: Java, Scala, Go, C++, or Python.
Experience with distributed systems, streaming, Spark, databases, data processing, or CDC.
## Pay Range Transparency
The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above.

probe.document_title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Infrastructure - Databricks

lines: ## The Opportunity

You will tackle the hard problems of distributed systems: sub-second container/MicroVM startup times, multi-tenant security isolation, and building a unified orchestration layer that scales across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
## What You’ll Do
Design and build the next generation of our Serverless platform, focusing on high availability, low latency, and scale-to-zero efficiency.
Work alongside industry experts who have built world-class systems like Borg, Kubernetes, and Uber’s infrastructure.
## What We’re Looking For
5+ years of production-level experience in one of: Python, Java, Scala, C++, or a similar language
4+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems from scratch
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or MicroVM technologies (e.g., Firecracker) and a strong grasp of cloud provider internals (AWS/Azure/GCP).
## Pay Range Transparency
The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above.
## The Role
Databricks is seeking a Staff Systems Development Engineer (GovOps) to join our Cleared Engineering team in McLean, VA.
## The Impact You’ll Have

Uphold & Evolve Compliance Guardrails: Navigate and refine operational frameworks inside secure facilities (SCIF), ensuring platform interactions and deployment pipelines strictly align with FedRAMP High, ITAR/IL5, and federal security benchmarks.
## What We're Looking For
Required: Candidates have active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance.
Nice to have: Possession of a current polygraph (Counterintelligence or Full Scope) is highly desired and considered a significant plus.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Senior Support Engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical operations role.
Deep expertise in Linux/Unix operating-system internals, networking, process/resource debugging, and distributed systems.
Hands-on proficiency in Python, Bash, Go, or Java with the ability to read source code, debug software defects, and write custom diagnostic scripts.
Proven experience managing, debugging, and operating cloud infrastructure across public or federal cloud boundaries (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or GCP).
Solid working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation, along with container orchestration mechanics (Docker/Kubernetes).
3+ years of experience writing clear, succinct written and verbal technical communications, including technical status reports, incident summaries, or cross-team escalations.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience supporting AWS Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS), isolated defense integration networks, or FedRAMP High / ITAR environments.
## Pay Range Transparency
The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above.

lines: ## Responsibilities
Navigate a complex fintech environment with numerous compliance regulations, translating internal and external business needs into robust software requirements and scalable distributed systems;
Build large-scale (petabyte-size) financial data platforms, solutions, and pipelines using Big Data technologies and distributed systems;
## Minimum requirements

Must have a Bachelor's Degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Security, or a related field, plus five (5) years of related work experience in Software Engineering.
## Must also have experience in each of the following
5 years of experience programming in Java, Scala, or Python;
5 years of experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable distributed systems;
5 years of experience debugging production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack;
5 years of experience with different testing tools and frameworks including JUnit, Mockito, and TestNG;
4 years of experience developing complex SQL queries, analyzing datasets and designing large-scale data pipelines;
4 years of experience working in fintech domain;
4 years of experience leading cross-team projects and building alignment on multi-team technical direction; and
1 year experience working with Apache Spark or similar modern Big Data technologies.
Multiple Positions Available.
Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

Develop scalable computer systems that manage a large volume of information and use them to fulfill business goals for the company and its partners.
Improve backend scalability and performance by integrating lightweight backend framework, overhauling APIs and optimizing database systems.
Design and implement scalable and reliable automated testing suites to reduce manual Quality Assurance tasks.
## Minimum requirements
Must have a Master's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, plus six (6) years of software development experience.
## Must also have four (4) years of experience in each of the following
Building software solutions in Java, C++, Python, or Ruby;
Designing, building and maintaining scalable systems;
Distributed systems; and
Design and implementation of scalable high-performance RESTful microservices.
